subject: problems importing DArT object with dartRverse & loading previous workspace...

messages.author: 722521532a54784f
messages.subject: problems importing DArT object with dartRverse & loading previous workspace...
parts:
Hi everyone,
sorry to be a pain, but I wanted to test some of the new dartRverse functions, following the workshop, and I already encountered some issues both in loading previous workspace (obtained with the previous version of dartR and R 
/RStudio 2022.07.0) and in importing DArT data with the dartRverse packages.

Soecifically, I have re-installed R and RStudio (the latest versions of both) on a separate computer (from the one I normally use for the analysis) and followed the instructions to install dartRverse and the other external packages (captive, spatial, popgen and sex.linked). So, all packages required are the most up to date too.

However, when I try to load the workspace I used so far with the previous version of dartR, it tells me:

Error in load("~/dartRverse code/BlacktipSNP.Rdata") :

  bad restore file magic number (file may be corrupted) -- no data loaded

In addition: Warning messages:

1: In readChar(con, 5L, useBytes = TRUE) :

  truncating string with embedded nuls

2: file ‘BlacktipSNP.Rdata’ has magic number 'X'

  Use of save versions prior to 2 is deprecated


Then, I tried to import the DArT object directly, like this:

Blacktips2024 = gl.read.dart(

filename = "C:/gabry/dartRverse code/Report_DCarcha22-7027_SNP_mapping_2.csv”,

ind.metafile="C:/gabry/dartRverse code/sharks_metadata_DArT.csv")


And it does seem to work and import the data, reading the correct number of individuals (428) but it reads the wrong number of SNPs 59523 instead of 116556.


Have I done something wrong?

When I installed the sex.linked package like this:

  dartRverse_install(package = "dartR.sexlinked",

                     rep = "github", branch = "dev")

the system asked me if I wanted to update the required packages and I said yes without thinking so much, so I think it updated dartR.base from github. I thought this might be the problem, so I tried to re-install dartRverse from the star,t but I get the same problem.

Any idea?

I would appreciate any help!!

Thanks a lot in advance!

Best,

Gabriella

messages.author: 722521532a54784f
messages.subject: Re: problems importing DArT object with dartRverse & loading previous workspace...
parts:
Hi everyone,
just a feedback on this issue.
I managed to figure out where the problem was, at least I think! :p

The problem emerged because I used a different computer (with a different Microsoft tools packages version) to install and test dartRverse.
When I tried to import the DArT .csv file with the dartRverse package installed in this new computer, I got the wrong reading of SNPs, as outlined in my message above.
So, I tried to install a previous version of dartR in a separate library folder on the same PC, to test whether the problem of importing properly the DArT object was within the new dartRverse package.
I installed dartR 2.7.2, but then I had the same problem: gl.read.dart read ~59000 SNPs instead of ~ 116000.

However, there was a warning message below:
"Warning message: 
In scan(file = file, what = what, sep = sep, quote = quote, dec = dec,  :
    embedded nul(s) found in input"

So, when I googled this, it turns out it may be an incompatibility issue between .csv files imported with different versions of Excel, using different encoding methods (i.e. UTF-16LE) -->
https://stackoverflow.com/questions/23209464/get-embedded-nuls-found-in-input-when-reading-a-csv-using-read-csv

So, instead of reading the file that I had originally imported with the Excel version in my previous computer, I transferred in the new computer the original .csv file from DArT never opened before in my previous PC, and voila': dartR now reads 116000 SNPs - the correct number of SNPs.

I also tested dartRverse::dartR.base, like this:
dartR::gl.rad.dart(filename = "C:/myDArT.csv", ind.metafile = ("C:/myMetadata.csv") # --> and it reads the correct number of SNPs too! :) 

I just wanted to let everyone know, in case by any chance you encounter the same or a similar problem!!

And for the dartR staff - sorry to have freaked you out!  dartR.base::gl.read.dart works fine! (at least for me!)

Thanks a lot!
Happy Easter
Gabry

messages.subject: Re: [dartR] Re: problems importing DArT object with dartRverse & loading previous workspace...
parts:
Hi Gabriella,

This sounds like a csv coding problem. Be aware there are 3 different csv version when you save from excel and you should not use the utf 16 coded version nor the Mac version I think. 

When you open the utf encoded version in a text editor you see a funny character in the first position. So this is my test to check if it is encoded correctly or not.

Cheers, Bernd
